faqHandbook.intro: Bo du lieu chuan hoa chapter 10-12 cho BE/FE codegen.

generalFaq.question: Phap Mon Tam Linh la gi?
generalFaq.answer: Phap mon thuoc truyen thong Dai thua, tap trung vao Ngu Dai Phap Bao de giai quyet kho khan doi song va huong tu tap.

generalFaq.question: Tu hoc co ton phi khong?
generalFaq.answer: Theo tai lieu noi bo, phap mon huong den viec tu hoc mien phi, chi doi hoi su kien tri va tinh tan.

generalFaq.question: Moi lan cau xin nen cau may viec?
generalFaq.answer: Nen giu toi da 1-3 viec cu the de tranh phan tan nguyen luc.

generalFaq.question: Co the niem kinh cho nguoi than khong?
generalFaq.answer: Co the, nhung can xung ro ten doi tuong va giu dung nghi thuc theo huong dan.

faqEntries.question: In NNN bang giay mau gi?
faqEntries.answer: Dung giay vang chanh theo mau chuan.

faqEntries.question: Viet NNN bang but nao?
faqEntries.answer: Noi dung ten dung but xanh/den, cham vong tron dung but do.

faqEntries.question: Cham do NNN nhu the nao?
faqEntries.answer: Cham vao giua vong tron, khong danh dau cheo, khong lem.

faqEntries.question: Gio dot NNN tot nhat?
faqEntries.answer: Thuong uu tien ban ngay khi troi on dinh.

faqEntries.question: Dung dung cu gi de dot NNN?
faqEntries.answer: Dung kep/nhiep va dung cu sach, thao tac nhe, khong cau tha.

faqEntries.question: Xu ly tro NNN the nao?
faqEntries.answer: Thu gom gon gang va bo dung noi quy dinh ve ve sinh.

faqEntries.question: Co duoc dot chung NNN voi vang ma khong?
faqEntries.answer: Khong khuyen nghi dot chung; can tach biet nghiem tuc theo huong dan.

faqEntries.question: Viet sai NNN xu ly ra sao?
faqEntries.answer: Khong xu ly tuy tien; theo dung quy trinh huy va lam lai dung phap.

faqEntries.question: Co duoc tu ton NNN khong?
faqEntries.answer: Co the, nhung phai theo dung quy trinh va muc dich.

faqEntries.question: Neu nha co hien tuong la thi lam sao?
faqEntries.answer: Uu tien giu binh tinh, tham chieu huong dan chinh thong va xu ly dung nghi thuc.

faqEntries.question: Khung gio nao can tranh niem kinh?
faqEntries.answer: Can tranh khung gio duoc liệt ke trong huong dan thuc hanh an toan.

faqEntries.question: Kinh nao can han che niem ban dem?
faqEntries.answer: Mot so bai nhay cam theo thoi diem, can bam huong dan canon.

faqEntries.question: Dang niem bi gian doan thi sao?
faqEntries.answer: Dung cau tam dung theo huong dan, xong viec tiep tuc dung quy trinh.

faqEntries.question: Nen doc thanh tieng hay doc tham?
faqEntries.answer: Giu am luong vua du, on dinh nhip, tranh gang suc.

faqEntries.question: Dau hieu kich hoat nghiep khi sam hoi la gi?
faqEntries.answer: Co the co cam giac kho chiu; xu ly theo huong dan ket hop phap bao.

faqEntries.question: Nuoc Dai Bi dung nhu the nao?
faqEntries.answer: Giup tang tinh trang nghiem, dung dung cach va giu ve sinh.

faqEntries.question: Moi vi tren ban tho can may coc nuoc?
faqEntries.answer: Theo bo cuc huong dan, su dung nhat quan va sach se.

faqEntries.question: Trai cay nao nen tranh cung?
faqEntries.answer: Can theo danh sach kiêng ky trong huong dan chuan.

faqEntries.question: So luong trai cay cung the nao?
faqEntries.answer: Ap dung nguyen tac so luong theo tung tang dia, nhat quan.

faqEntries.question: Dung loai dau nao cho den dau?
faqEntries.answer: Uu tien loai dau duoc phep theo huong dan, tranh mui qua manh.

faqEntries.question: Tat den dau bang cach nao?
faqEntries.answer: Tat dung cach, khong thao tac vo y theo thoi quen thong thuong.

faqEntries.question: Huong tram (Grand Incense) dung khi nao?
faqEntries.answer: Dung trong ngay dac biet theo huong dan, giu tinh trang nghiem.

faqEntries.question: Vi pham nguyen luc co hau qua gi?
faqEntries.answer: Can xem nghiem tuc, sam hoi va dieu chinh theo huong dan.

faqEntries.question: Phong sinh ma sinh vat chet thi sao?
faqEntries.answer: Xu ly theo nghi thuc sieu do duoc quy dinh.

faqEntries.question: Mo thay rung rang ham duoi co y nghia gi?
faqEntries.answer: Duoc coi la dau hieu can than trong; uu tien tang canh bao va hoa giai som.

faqEntries.question: Mo thay nguoi la mac do den la gi?
faqEntries.answer: Duoc dien giai la can xu ly nghiep duyen, can bam huong dan tu hoc dung phap.

faqEntries.question: Phap mon co bi tranh cai khong?
faqEntries.answer: Co tranh cai o mot so noi; can tiep can than trong, ton trong phap luat so tai.

faqEntries.question: Phat tu Viet Nam tu hoc cach nao?
faqEntries.answer: Chu yeu tu hoc tai gia, bam tai lieu chuan va khong to chuc trai phep.

faqEntries.question: Don doi ten tam linh dung de lam gi?
faqEntries.answer: Dung de dong bo ten su dung trong nghi thuc theo huong dan.

faqEntries.question: Lam sao de nguoi nha ung ho ma khong cai va?
faqEntries.answer: Uu tien on hoa, tranh tranh chap, van dong bang hanh vi va thuc hanh ben bi.
